Let's work through this systematically.

transcript.text: Before we proceed, I need to flag something critical. In the exposure report I reviewed this morning, the bank already has $4 million of exposure to this issuer. Our applicable single-issuer limit is $10 million. This position has not yet been added to the committee packet, so you may not have been aware of it. A $12 million face value purchase would bring our total exposure to $16 million, which exceeds the $10 million single-issuer limit by $6 million. Credit risk cannot approve this purchase without either a waiver of the single-issuer limit or a reduction in the purchase size to stay within the $6 million of remaining capacity.
